```plato
    //==
    // # Fits
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_linear_regression
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coefficient_of_determination

    // The fitted value at x: Slope * x + Intercept.
    Predict(self: LinearFit, x: Number): Number
        => self.Slope * x + self.Intercept;
```

## Line 262

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/statistics.library.plato, line 262](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/statistics.library.plato#L262).

```plato

    // The fitted value at x, by Horner evaluation of the ASCENDING-power
    // coefficient array (Coefficients[k] multiplies x^k).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horner%27s_method
    Predict(self: PolynomialFit, x: Number): Number
        => self.Coefficients.Count.Range
            .Map(k => self.Coefficients[k] * x.Pow(k.ToNumber))
            .Reduce(0.0, (total, term) => total + term);
```
